title: City Council Regular Session Meeting 9/1/2026
agendaText: City Council Regular Session Meeting - September 01, 2026 Agenda Full Package Agenda Full Package Open Video in new Window Video City Council Agenda Campbell Police Department EOC 100 N. First Street, Campbell, California ATTENTION: This meeting is being held at an alternate location and will not be conducted in the City Hall Council Chambers. Please see meeting location above. Location map will be provided on the City's website Agenda Center with the posting of this agenda. This City Council Regular meeting will be conducted in person as well as telecommunication and is compliant with provisions of the Brown Act. The City Council meeting will be live-streamed on Channel 26 (Xfinity) or Channel 88 (Direct TV), the City's website and on YouTube https://www.youtube.com/user/CityofCampbell for those who only wish to view the meeting. Those members of the public wishing to provide public comment virtually are asked to register in advance at: https://www.campbellca.gov/signup . After registering, you will receive a confirmation email containing information about joining the meeting. Members of the public may attend the meeting in person at Campbell City Hall - Council Chambers. Public comment will also be accepted via email at [email protected] until 12:00 p.m. prior to the start of the meeting. Written comments will be posted on the website and distributed to the Council. If you choose to email your comments, please indicate in the subject line “FOR PUBLIC COMMENT” and indicate the item number. REGULAR MEETING OF THE CAMPBELL CITY COUNCIL Tuesday, September 01, 2026 07:00 PM Campbell Police Department EOC 1. CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL 2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE 3. SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS Please Note: Items listed under Special Presentations and Proclamations are considered ceremonial. The City Council will not take action on these matters. 3.1 Proclamation Declaring the Month of September 2026 as National Childhood Cancer Awareness Month 1. Report - Proclamation for Childhood Cancer Awareness Month 2026.pdf 2. Proclamation - Childhood Cancer Awareness 2026.pdf Recommended Action That the Mayor proclaim September 2026, as National Childhood Cancer Awareness Month in the City of Campbell. 4. COMMUNICATIONS AND PETITIONS 5. ORAL REQUESTS NOTE: This portion of the meeting is reserved for persons wishing to address the City Council on any matter not on the agenda. Persons wishing to address the Council are requested, but not required to complete a Speaker’s Card. Speakers are limited to two (2) minutes. The law generally prohibits the Council from discussion or taking action on such items. However, the Council may instruct staff accordingly regarding Oral Requests. 6. COUNCIL ANNOUNCEMENTS 7. CONSENT CALENDAR NOTE: All matters listed under consent calendar are considered by the City Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a request is made by a member of City Council, City staff, or a member of the public. Any person wishing to speak on any item on the consent calendar should ask to have the item removed from the consent calendar prior to the time the Council votes to approve. If removed, the item will be discussed in the order in which it appears. 7.1 Minutes of City Council Executive Session Meeting of August 18, 2026 1. PostMinutes - Package City Council Executive Session _Aug18_2026 (1).pdf Recommended Action Approve the executive session meeting minutes of August 18, 2026. 7.2 Minutes of City Council Regular Minutes of August 18, 2026 1. PostMinutes - Package City Council Regular Session Meeting_Aug18_2026 (2).pdf Recommended Action Approve the regular meeting minutes of August 18, 2026. 7.3 Approving Payment of Bills and Claims 1. Report-Approving Bills and Claims - 09.01.26.pdf Recommended Action Approve the bills and claims in the amount of $2,145,540.83. 7.4 Monthly Investment Transactions Report- July 2026 1. Monthly Investment Transactions Report- July 2026.pdf 2. Monthly Investment tranx rpt- Jul'26.pdf 3. Chandler BNY Investment Statement- 7.31.26.pdf Recommended Action That the City Council review and accept the Monthly Investment Transactions Report for July 2026. 7.5 Monthly Treasurer’s Report (July 2026) 1. Monthly Treasurer's Report July 2026.pdf 2. 2026.07 Fund Balance report.pdf Recommended Action That the City Council review and accept the Monthly Treasurer’s Report for the month ended July 31, 2026. 8. PUBLIC HEARINGS AND INTRODUCTIONS OF ORDINANCES NOTE: Members of the public may be allotted up to two (2) minutes to comment on any public hearing item. Applicants/Appellants and their representatives may be allotted up to a total of five (5) minutes for opening statements and up to a total of three (3) minutes maximum for closing statements. Items requested/recommended for continuance are subject to Council’s consent at the meeting. 9. NEW BUSINESS 9.1 Response to Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury Report Regarding the Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority (”VTA”) 1. Response to Civil Grand Jury Report Regarding VTA Board Appointments.pdf 2. Transmittal Letter to Presiding Judge_Responding to VTA Grand Jury Report.pdf 3. Exhibit A to Transmittal Letter Responding to Grand Jury Report.pdf 4. 2025-26 Grand Jury Report_VTA Board.pdf Recommended Action That the City Council authorize the Mayor to submit a letter as the City’s response to the 2025-2026 Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury Report titled, "VTA’s Management and Oversight of BART Silicon Valley Phase II." 9.2 Response to 2025-2026 Civil Grand Jury Report on Pothole Damage Claims Processes 1. Report - Response to 2025-2026 Civil Grand Jury Report on Pothole Damage Claims Processes. .pdf 2. Attachment 1 - Civil Grand Jury Response Letter - Potholes and Claims Process (City of Campbell 09-01-26).pdf 3. Attachment 2 - 2025-2025 Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury Report - Pothole Damage and Claims Processes.pdf Recommended Action That the City Council authorize the Mayor to submit, on behalf of the City Council, the attached letter as the City’s response to the 2025-2026 Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury Report, “Pothole Damage: Improving claims processes within Santa Clara County.” 9.3 Authorization To Execute Low Carbon Transportation and Operations Program (LCTOP) Fund Agreement (Resolution/Roll Call Vote) 1. report-authorization to execute LCTOP fund agreement for TRIPS project 9-1-26 new business.pdf 2. Resolution-Authorization to execute LCTOP fund agreement for TRIPS project 9-1-26 new business.pdf 3. VTA_Campbell_Agreement_TRIPS_Clean.pdf Recommended Action Adoption of a Resolution for Authorization to Execute Low Carbon Transportation and Operations Program (LCTOP) Fund Agreement for Transit Reliability Improvement and Performance System (TRIPS) Project. 10. UNFINISHED BUSINESS 11. COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS 11.1 Council Committee Reports 1. Report - Council Committee Reports 9.1.26.pdf Recommended Action That the City Council report on activities from their committee assignments. 12. ADJOURN IMPORTANT NOTICE: Materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the City Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection with the agenda packet in the lobby of City Clerk’s Office, 70 N. First Street, Campbell, CA 95008, during normal business hours. These materials will also be available on the City website at https://pub-campbell.escribemeetings.com with the agenda packet following the last item of the agenda, subject to staff’s ability to post the documents prior to the meeting. All documents not posted prior to the meeting will be posted the next business day. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, listening assistive devices are available for all meetings held in the City Council Chambers. If you require accommodation, please contact the City Clerk’s Office, (408) 866-2117, at least one week in advance of the meeting. No Item Selected This item has no attachments 1.
